svg.text: An agentic assistant for EV operations: it investigates in laps, answers from evidence, and learns from feedback.
Observability: every turn traced in Langfuse, each lap a span
actual vs normal, Δ% in code
Thresholds, schema and versioned prompts live in config files, not code.
Groq LLMs: a fast 8B model and a strong 70B model.
Local embeddings and reranker: no cost, no data leaves the machine.
a fixed failure can't come back:
every prompt or config change is tested
Numbers mark the path of one question: 0 data in, 1 ask, 2 understand, 3 investigate, 4 answer, 5 verify, 6 learn.
